tooltip.veilborne.conch: Use to hear the call left by the celestial sea.
tooltip.veilborne.mantle: Use: slow falling for 30 seconds. Cooldown: 60 seconds.
tooltip.veilborne.journal: Use to read your notes on the veil.
tooltip.veilborne.message: A current brought it ashore. Use to open.
tooltip.veilborne.attuner: Use under open sky to consume it and call a complete Inverted Sea.
message.veilborne.bottle: The note reads: "The sea is above us. The ship upon the whale still seeks its home shore." You keep a bottle of the tide.
message.veilborne.skiff: The Shoreless Skiff · The old fisherman nods. Hold forward and he sails the way you look; sneak to step off
message.veilborne.conch_active: The conch replies softly: the sea has not yet receded.
message.veilborne.conch_quiet: A distant whale call, like a dream that never quite ended.
message.veilborne.attuner_blocked: Find open sky in the Overworld while no Inverted Sea is active.
message.veilborne.record.1: Observation · The first drop of rising starlight
message.veilborne.record.4: Observation · A scale from beyond the sky
message.veilborne.record.8: Observation · A letter from the shoreless coast
journal.veilborne.title: The Inverted Sea
journal.veilborne.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.epigraph: First a single drop falls upward into the night. Then the sea opens overhead.
journal.veilborne.quiet: The veil is quiet. Watch for the first drop rising from the water.
journal.veilborne.phase.omen.text: Drops leave the water and rise. A whale calls far away.
journal.veilborne.phase.opening.text: The clouds part and the inverted sea unfolds.
journal.veilborne.phase.flood.text: Light falls pour down; visitors come ashore.
journal.veilborne.phase.whale.text: The whale crosses the sky, a wreck upon its back.
journal.veilborne.phase.afterglow.text: A beam touches down where a scale awaits.
journal.veilborne.phase.ebb.text: The sea rolls back into the sky; the tide fades.
journal.veilborne.bottle.text: At high tide a thin current brings it ashore near you. Open it to keep a bottle of the tide.
journal.veilborne.skiff.text: An old fisherman angles for stars a few blocks above the ground. Board with use; sneak to step off; hold forward and he sails the way you look.
journal.veilborne.vortex.text: The gold ring is a warning. When it turns cyan, anyone inside rises gently and lands with slow falling. Step out to decline.
journal.veilborne.scale.text: After the whale passes, five scales come down scattered round the beam, and each goes out within 45 seconds: catch them before they do. A star-tide pool is left there too.
journal.veilborne.conch.text: Hold it close and tonight's whale song still sounds.
journal.veilborne.mantle.text: Woven from scales and phantom membrane. Slow falling for 30 s, 60 s cooldown.
journal.veilborne.attuner: Use under open Overworld sky to call a complete sea. It is not consumed if a sea is already here or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.lantern.text: Set the bottle down at home; it glows and breathes out tiny motes.
journal.veilborne.hint.1: See the rising light for yourself.
journal.veilborne.hint.2: Stand under open sky as the whale passes.
journal.veilborne.hint.4: Catch the scale the whale lets fall.
journal.veilborne.hint.8: Open a bottle that came ashore.
journal.veilborne.note.0: The weather never breaks buildings, empties chests or carries anyone off.
journal.veilborne.note.1: You can hear the tide indoors; it is clearer by doors and windows.
journal.veilborne.note.2: Leave the region and the sky slowly returns to normal.
journal.veilborne.closing: The sea withdraws. On your roof, a shell is still breathing.
tooltip.veilborne.moon_dew: Drink: night vision for 60 seconds; clears darkness and blindness.
tooltip.veilborne.moon_shard: A flake of the moon's shell; its broken edge still holds gold light.
tooltip.veilborne.moon_gauze: Use: leave a moonlit likeness that draws hostile attention, and turn briefly invisible. Cooldown 30 s.
tooltip.veilborne.moon_dial: When three moons hang, aim at the one you believe is real and use it.
tooltip.veilborne.moon_bell: Use under open sky to consume it and call a complete Moon-Husk Bloom.
message.veilborne.bell_blocked: Find open Overworld sky while no other veil weather is under way.
message.veilborne.dial_quiet: The needle only drifts. There is no moon to tell apart tonight.
message.veilborne.dial_waiting: The needle trembles; it is not yet time.
message.veilborne.dial_settled: Only one moon remains in the sky.
message.veilborne.dial_aim: Aim at one of the moons first, then use the dial.
message.veilborne.dial_false: The needle swings away: that one is a reflection.
message.veilborne.dial_true: The needle holds still. The two reflections flake away like broken porcelain, and the true moon returns to its place.
message.veilborne.dew: You catch a bottle of moon dew.
message.veilborne.dew_empty: The little moon has already given you all it can.
message.veilborne.record.32: Observation · The first shard to reach the ground
message.veilborne.record.64: Observation · Watched the moon shed its shell
message.veilborne.record.128: Observation · Walked beside the moon bearers
message.veilborne.record.256: Observation · A constellation true from one place only
message.veilborne.record.512: Observation · Told the true moon from its reflections
message.veilborne.record.1024: Observation · Someone waved from the empty place
journal.veilborne.hint.32: See the falling petals for yourself.
journal.veilborne.hint.64: Stand under open sky when the shell comes away.
journal.veilborne.hint.128: Keep your distance from the bearers and walk with them a while.
journal.veilborne.hint.256: Stand in the gold ring beside the little moon and look at it.
journal.veilborne.hint.512: When three moons hang, use the silver dial on the true one.
journal.veilborne.hint.1024: Carry a silver lantern close to the place that is always empty.
journal.veilborne.moon.title: Moon-Husk Bloom
journal.veilborne.moon.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.moon.epigraph: The moon's shell cracks into thin porcelain, and what falls into the night becomes flowers.
journal.veilborne.moon.quiet: The veil is quiet. Watch for a ring around the moon.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.halo.text: A ring forms around the moon; shadows begin to lengthen.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.crack.text: Gold light seeps through the cracks; the first flakes fall.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.bloom.text: Flakes turn to petals; silver flowers open where they land.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.molt.text: The shell comes away, and three moons hang in the sky.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.farewell.te: The bearers leave a lantern by the road.
journal.veilborne.moon.phase.close.text: The shell closes again; the flowers close ring by ring.
journal.veilborne.moon.bearers.text: Faceless, veiled figures carry a piece of the shell. Walk beside them at a distance and a flower road shows where they are going; walk into their line and they scatter into petals.
journal.veilborne.moon.little_moon.text: A tiny moon floating among the trees. Hold an empty bottle near it to catch moon dew, and stand in the gold ring to look at it.
journal.veilborne.moon.three_moons.text: Petals always blow from the true moon, and moon-shadows point away from it. Aim the silver dial at it and the reflections break; the sooner you tell it, the more shards and dew are left.
journal.veilborne.moon.dew.text: A bottle of the little moon's light. Drink for night vision; also used for moon gauze and silver lanterns.
journal.veilborne.moon.shard.text: A few are left when the true moon is found, when the little moon leaves, and where the lantern is set down.
journal.veilborne.moon.lantern.text: The lantern the last bearer sets by the road. No monster comes out of the dark within 24 blocks of it; break it to take it home.
journal.veilborne.moon.bell: Use under open Overworld sky to call a complete bloom. It is not consumed while another weather is under way or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.moon.lantern_craft.tex: Moonshell shards, moon dew and a chain make one too; at home it gives a soft silver light.
journal.veilborne.moon.note.0: The weather never breaks buildings, empties chests or carries anyone off. The bearers never enter a house.
journal.veilborne.moon.note.1: Your moon-shadow moves half a beat behind you. If that feels unsettling, shorten or turn it off in the client settings.
journal.veilborne.moon.note.2: Inside the flower tide you may hear pieces of a lullaby.
journal.veilborne.moon.closing: The shell has closed. The lantern by the road is still lit.
tooltip.veilborne.mirror_sand: Every grain is a very small mirror.
tooltip.veilborne.mirror_prism: Hold use to raise it to your eye and see what only the mirror shows.
tooltip.veilborne.mirror_echo: Use: show the path you walked in the last half minute. Cooldown 30 s.
tooltip.veilborne.mirror_sky_mirror: Raise it under open sky to consume it and call a complete Mirror-Sky Pilgrimage.
message.veilborne.sky_mirror_blocked: Find open Overworld sky while no other veil weather is under way.
message.veilborne.door_revealed: In the prism a frame of light rises on the wall: the door from the mirror is here too.
message.veilborne.door_closed: The frame is fading. The mirror is about to break; the door will not open now.
message.veilborne.door_sealed: The door does not answer. (The gallery is disabled in this world.)
message.veilborne.gallery_enter: The Mirror Gallery · Your reflection runs a beat late. Use the door you came in by to leave
message.veilborne.gallery_warn: The gallery light is dimming; time to go back.
message.veilborne.gallery_time: The gallery set you back outside its door.
message.veilborne.gallery_closing: The mirror is breaking; the gallery has sent you back.
message.veilborne.gallery_reward: Your reflection reaches the pedestal at last and takes it down for you.
message.veilborne.frames_true: Only this one shows the present. The other two break into light.
message.veilborne.frames_late: The you in this mirror is half a beat late.
message.veilborne.frames_elsewhere: This mirror shows somewhere else; there is no one behind you.
message.veilborne.record.2048: Observation · The sky turned to silver
message.veilborne.record.4096: Observation · The pilgrim walked through the mirror
message.veilborne.record.8192: Observation · The door that was one too many
message.veilborne.record.16384: Observation · Your reflection fetched it for you
message.veilborne.record.32768: Observation · The mirror that showed the present
message.veilborne.record.65536: Observation · Caught up with the late traveller
message.veilborne.record.131072: Observation · The pilgrim in the mirror knew you
journal.veilborne.hint.2048: See the sky become a mirror.
journal.veilborne.hint.4096: Stand under open sky while the pilgrim walks the mirrored land toward you.
journal.veilborne.hint.8192: Find the door only the mirror has, and hold the prism on that spot in the world.
journal.veilborne.hint.16384: Go through that door and wait for your reflection to reach the pedestal.
journal.veilborne.hint.32768: Of three standing mirrors only one shows the present; find it with the prism.
journal.veilborne.hint.65536: Follow the one walking the path you walked, to where it stops.
journal.veilborne.mirror.title: Mirror-Sky Pilgrimage
journal.veilborne.mirror.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.mirror.epigraph: The sky became a not quite even mirror. The land hangs in it upside down, with one more door than the ground has.
journal.veilborne.mirror.quiet: The veil is quiet. Watch for still water showing a clear sky that does not belong to now.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.omen.text: Still water shows the clear sky of afterwards; some footsteps come back late.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.silver.te: Silver creeps down from the zenith like frost; the clouds go; shards turn in the air.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.reflect.t: The inverted land appears, with one more tower and one more door.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.pilgrim.t: The pilgrim crosses the mirrored land, stops beside you, turns and looks down at you.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.crack.tex: Cracks run across the whole sky like very slow lightning.
journal.veilborne.mirror.phase.clear.tex: The facets fall one by one as light, and the real sky returns.
journal.veilborne.mirror.door: The door that is one too many
journal.veilborne.mirror.door.text: Look up: in the mirror some wall has a door the ground lacks. Hold the observation prism on that wall and a frame of light appears; step through into the gallery.
journal.veilborne.mirror.traveler.text: A pale you walks again a stretch of the path you took a little while ago. It goes a few steps further and points at something worth seeing.
journal.veilborne.mirror.frames.text: Three standing mirrors all show you, but only one shows the present: one runs half a beat late, one shows somewhere else. Stand in the middle, watch, then pick it out with the prism.
journal.veilborne.mirror.beasts.text: Little glass creatures crawl on the low cracked shards. Come close and a high ringing and a ring of glints warn you; step back then and nothing happens, stay and the shard bursts. Beat the first wave and stay, and a larger one comes.
journal.veilborne.mirror.sand.text: Earned from the mirror that shows the present, from glass beasts, and from the gallery.
journal.veilborne.mirror.shard.text: The piece that lands at your feet when the mirror has fallen. Hang it on a wall; it still shows the land upside down.
journal.veilborne.mirror.sky_mirror: Raise it under open Overworld sky to call a complete pilgrimage. It is not consumed while another weather is under way or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.mirror.lantern.text: A bronze mirror behind a small flame throws the light one way only: toward you when you set it down.
journal.veilborne.mirror.note.0: The weather never breaks buildings or carries anyone off. You only enter the gallery by opening its door yourself, and its way out always leads back.
journal.veilborne.mirror.note.1: Late echoes and afterimages are only the mirror misbehaving; turn them off in the client settings if they bother you.
journal.veilborne.mirror.note.2: Glass beasts wake only if you come to their shard and stay after its warning.
journal.veilborne.mirror.closing: The mirror has fallen. In the small piece on the wall, the inverted land still drifts.
tooltip.veilborne.thread_thread: A thread end let down from the sky, still faintly warm.
tooltip.veilborne.thread_silk: Silk that has been sewn through time: touching it is like touching the seconds just gone.
tooltip.veilborne.thread_charm: Carried: the weather can no longer pull you or throw you.
tooltip.veilborne.thread_needle: Raise it under open sky to consume it and call a complete Scarlet Seam.
message.veilborne.needle_blocked: Find open Overworld sky while no other veil weather is under way.
message.veilborne.knot_undone: The knot comes undone: three loose ends fly out, and the walker turns on you!
message.veilborne.knot_caught: You caught all three ends first. The knot's heart is left in your hand: a strand of time-seam silk.
message.veilborne.anchor_tuning: The tuning anchor hums, and the old things floating in the pocket begin to drift toward it...
message.veilborne.record.524288: Observation · Watched the world being sewn
message.veilborne.record.2097152: Observation · Caught a loose thread end
message.veilborne.record.4194304: Observation · Undid the needle walker's knot
message.veilborne.record.16777216: Observation · You saw the thread that holds you
journal.veilborne.hint.262144: See the veil tear open for yourself.
journal.veilborne.hint.524288: Stand under open sky when the needle comes down into the land.
journal.veilborne.hint.1048576: Step into a warned ring on the ground, and out again before the needle falls.
journal.veilborne.hint.2097152: Catch a thread end drifting down from the sky.
journal.veilborne.hint.4194304: Touch the needle walker's knot, then catch its three loose ends before it does.
journal.veilborne.hint.8388608: Set a tuning anchor down inside the unsewn pocket.
journal.veilborne.thread.title: Scarlet Seam
journal.veilborne.thread.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.thread.epigraph: The robe of heaven has no seams. It is only that, every so many years, someone comes to mend it.
journal.veilborne.thread.quiet: The veil is quiet. Watch for a red thread hanging from nowhere.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.omen.text: Red threads hang from high places, dust drifts one way, and a gold hairline flickers across the sky.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.tear.text: The veil tears open from the middle; inside is a dark with no stars.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.needle.te: A golden needle comes through from the other side and sutures the wound, stitch by stitch.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.sew.text: The needle comes down into the land and sews the world to the sky; a hand nobody sees pulls the thread tight.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.knot.text: The thread is knotted in the sky and cut; the needle goes back into the seam.
journal.veilborne.thread.phase.fade.text: The seam cools into a gold line, and slowly into an ordinary band of stars.
journal.veilborne.thread.strike.text: First a broad ring of lines lights on the ground, dust spirals inward and a sound winds tighter. That is the warning: step out and nothing happens; stay and you are thrown down. Buildings are never harmed. Some say whoever stands at the very centre with a binding knot catches something of what falls.
journal.veilborne.thread.walker.text: A six-legged thing of brass that climbs down the thread a strike leaves, gathers loose ends from the ground and sits at the thread's foot tying a knot. Leave the knot alone, unless you want to race it for three loose ends.
journal.veilborne.thread.pocket.text: Where the needle left the land a small place stays unsewn: no wind gets in, and shadows of old things float there. Set a tuning anchor down inside to gather them into time-seam silk, but thread spirits will wake.
journal.veilborne.thread.thread.text: Thread ends let down while the needle sews; catch them and they are yours. The walker gathers them too.
journal.veilborne.thread.silk.text: From the heart of the walker's knot, or a tuned pocket. The tuning anchor, the sky-weaving lamp and the binding knot all need it.
journal.veilborne.thread.scrap.text: When the seam cools into stars, a small piece of the sky comes down beside you. Hang it on a wall; its stars still twinkle.
journal.veilborne.thread.needle: Raise it under open Overworld sky to call a complete sewing. It is not consumed while another weather is under way or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.thread.lantern.text: Sky-weaving lamps within ten blocks of each other are joined by a glowing red thread; sew two together with scarlet thread and you can follow the thread between them however far.
journal.veilborne.thread.note.0: The weather never breaks buildings or carries anyone off; the needle only comes down on open ground.
journal.veilborne.thread.note.1: When the thread is pulled, anyone out in the open is tugged gently toward the land stitch; stand on the line and you are holding it tight. A binding knot or a tuning anchor keeps you still. Before the pull you may also cut it with shears at a foot: then the world is not sewn, and no pair of lamps is left.
journal.veilborne.thread.note.2: For the seconds of the pull the world is overlaid with the moment just past, and every living thing has a thread above its head. If that is unsettling, turn it off in the client settings.
journal.veilborne.thread.closing: Only a very fine gold line is left in the sky. Some say the Milky Way was sewn like this once.
tooltip.veilborne.hush_wax: Pale and cool, and it makes no sound at all in your hand.
tooltip.veilborne.hush_bell: Ring it inside a veil weather to keep its sound; ring it later to let it out.
tooltip.veilborne.hush_clock: Raise it under open sky to consume it and call a complete Silent Daylight.
message.veilborne.clock_blocked: Find open Overworld sky while no other veil weather is under way.
message.veilborne.bell_recorded: The hollow bell keeps the sound of %s.
message.veilborne.record2.2: Observation · The black sun covered the sun
message.veilborne.record2.4: Observation · Answered the knock at the door
message.veilborne.record2.16: Observation · The silent procession raised its lantern to you
message.veilborne.record2.32: Observation · Waited out the late thunder
message.veilborne.record2.64: Observation · The black sun heard you
journal.veilborne.hint2.1: See the world lose its colour for yourself.
journal.veilborne.hint2.2: Stand under open sky while the black sun covers the sun.
journal.veilborne.hint2.4: When the knocking comes, open the door and raise a light to what stands outside.
journal.veilborne.hint2.8: Follow the ringing to the one bell that still sounds.
journal.veilborne.hint2.16: Raise a light to the silent procession as it passes.
journal.veilborne.hint2.32: When the white line stands on the horizon, stay where you are and wait for its thunder.
journal.veilborne.hush.title: Silent Daylight
journal.veilborne.hush.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.hush.epigraph: When the world had gone quite silent, there came a single soft knock at the door.
journal.veilborne.hush.quiet: The veil is quiet. Notice if the music ever stops for no reason.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.omen.text: First the music stops, then the wind, the caves and the animals, and at last your own footsteps; the dust in the air stops where it is.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.fade.text: Grey comes in like a tide from the horizon to your feet; the world pales, and only lamps keep a little warmth, sepia, like an old photograph.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.sun.text: A black sun that gives no light rises in the north; the sky bends around it, and the colours of the world drain into it in threads.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.eclipse.tex: The black sun covers the sun: nothing darkens; everything goes white and shadowless. Nothing sounds, and a black corona hangs about it.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.thunder.tex: The black sun sinks back into the north. A straight white line stands on the horizon, and its thunder arrives half a minute later.
journal.veilborne.hush.phase.return.text: First a bird, then the grass underfoot; colour comes back outward from where you stand, and the sky last of all.
journal.veilborne.hush.procession.text: A file of travellers in the clothes of another age walks the land: a lantern-bearer, a woman under an umbrella, a child with an empty birdcage, an old man with a stick, a tall man with a suitcase. Their mouths move; nothing is heard. Raise a light and they stop, and their lantern goes up in answer.
journal.veilborne.hush.knock.text: When you are near a house, a long coat with nobody in it stands outside the door and every so often knocks three times. Open the door and raise a light to it: it bows, leaves daylight wax on the threshold, and is rubbed out like a pencil drawing. It never opens the door itself.
journal.veilborne.hush.bell.text: Somewhere one bell is still ringing, hung under a tree, from a rock edge, or from nothing at all. Each time it rings, a ring of colour goes out through the grey. Walk up to it and sound and colour come back around it: a small island of sound.
journal.veilborne.hush.wax.text: A pale, cool lump of wax the empty coat leaves on the threshold. The child in the procession gives you one too.
journal.veilborne.hush.hollow.text: The bell that comes down when the island of sound closes. Ring it inside any veil weather and it keeps a little of that weather's sound; ring it anywhere afterwards and it gives the sound back. Holding nothing, it rings a moment of silence.
journal.veilborne.hush.feather.text: The jay’s blue feather that hung motionless in mid-air beside you once the colour had gone, and only fell when the first bird sang. Under its glass it still does not move; now and then something in there chirps.
journal.veilborne.hush.clock: Raise it under open Overworld sky to call a complete silent daylight. It is not consumed while another weather is under way or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.hush.raise.text: In the silence a light is your voice: hold a torch, a lantern, glowstone or anything that glows, and use it at the open air (not at a block) to raise it. The procession and the empty coat both answer; a silent lantern reaches further, and shows the footprints the procession never leaves.
journal.veilborne.hush.note.0: The weather never breaks buildings or carries anyone off. Creatures, redstone, arrows and time all go on as usual; only sound and colour leave.
journal.veilborne.hush.note.1: Hostile mobs, hurt sounds and subtitles always stay. If you would rather the world did not go silent or grey, turn either off in the client settings.
journal.veilborne.hush.note.2: Set a still candle down at home and the world near it is a little quieter and greyer, and the sculk hears nothing there. Ring a bell, play a note or blow a horn on purpose in the silence and something under the ground hears it; you do not have to.
journal.veilborne.hush.closing: First a bird found its voice again, then the grass underfoot, and last the sky got back its colour.
tooltip.veilborne.dream_seed: Plant it in open-sky soil, grass or moss and it grows into a small dream tree.
tooltip.veilborne.dream_full_seed: So full it glows. Planted, it grows a taller dream tree with gold-edged leaves.
tooltip.veilborne.dream_leaf: A leaf that came off the great golden fish.
tooltip.veilborne.dream_charm: Carried: when you fall, you drift down like a leaf. Each fall uses a little of it.
tooltip.veilborne.dream_flute: Blow it under open sky to consume it and call a complete Verdant Dream.
message.veilborne.flute_blocked: Find open sky in the Overworld while no other veil weather is under way.
message.veilborne.seed_hint: A dream seed hovers overhead. Crouch, or come near holding a flower, a sapling or a light, and it follows you; bring it down to the soil.
message.veilborne.enclosure: Vine shadows grow round you, a gap left behind you. Follow the lights as they come.
message.veilborne.record2.128: Observation · The forest came down out of the clouds
message.veilborne.record2.256: Observation · The great deer walked past you
message.veilborne.record2.512: Observation · Followed the petal path to the dream tree
message.veilborne.record2.1024: Observation · The deer lowered its head and looked at you
message.veilborne.record2.2048: Observation · Guided a dream seed down to the soil
message.veilborne.record2.4096: Observation · Led the lost leaf-fish back to the sky
message.veilborne.record2.16384: Observation · A dream seed landed in the deer's hoofprint
journal.veilborne.hint2.128: See the upside-down forest for yourself.
journal.veilborne.hint2.256: When the deer passes, be under open sky and not too far from its road.
journal.veilborne.hint2.512: Glowing petals lay out a path; follow it to its end.
journal.veilborne.hint2.1024: When the deer stops by the dream tree, have been standing quietly beneath it a while.
journal.veilborne.hint2.2048: In the seedfall, lead a hovering seed down to open-sky soil.
journal.veilborne.hint2.4096: Find the leaf-fish stuck at a window and lead them out into the open with a flower or a flower lamp.
journal.veilborne.hint2.8192: Touch the wandering seed, then catch its five lights before the vines close.
journal.veilborne.dream.title: Verdant Dream
journal.veilborne.dream.subtitle: Field Journal of the Veil
journal.veilborne.dream.epigraph: A forest grew upside down out of the clouds. A deer carrying a whole wood in its antlers walked by along its roots.
journal.veilborne.dream.quiet: The veil is quiet. Watch for clouds gone soft as down, green at their edges.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.omen.text: The clouds go soft as down and green at the edges; seed fluff drifts slowly down.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.roots.text: Roots come down out of the clouds as far as the hilltops, and the canopy closes over them piece by piece.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.leaves.tex: The upside-down forest covers the sky and leaf-light moves over the land. Schools of leaf-fish swim past, and a glowing dream tree comes up nearby.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.deer.text: A road of roots comes down to the land. The great deer walks along it, stops by the dream tree and lowers its head to look.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.seedfall.t: Leaves turn gold and fall one by one, baring the veins of the branches; dream seeds come slowly down and hover over you.
journal.veilborne.dream.phase.return.tex: The roots draw back into the clouds, the dream tree folds its leaves, and at last only an ordinary cloud is left.
journal.veilborne.dream.deer: The deer that carries a wood
journal.veilborne.dream.deer.text: Its body is almost clear, and in its antlers grows a whole small wood with lamps in it. Wherever a hoof comes down a ring of flower-shadow opens on the land. The petal path is for it: stand quietly under the dream tree and it lowers its head to look at you, and a dream seed falls from its antlers.
journal.veilborne.dream.school.text: A small school of golden leaf-fish swam into a house and is pressed against a window, unable to find the way out. Come near holding a flower, a sapling or a flower lamp and they follow you; bring them out under open sky and they join into one great golden fish that swims back up, letting fall two golden leaves.
journal.veilborne.dream.wander.text: A dream seed drifts slowly round the crops or around you, never touching them. Touch it and vine shadows grow in a ring round you, a gap left behind; catch the five lights that come one after another before the vines close, and a full dream seed is yours. Walk out of the ring to give it up; nothing is lost by it.
journal.veilborne.dream.seed.text: In the seedfall three come down for each person. Crouch, or come near with a flower, and one follows you; brought down to open-sky soil it sprouts, and leaves you a seed. Landed in one of the deer's hoofprints, it might come up differently.
journal.veilborne.dream.leaf.text: A leaf that falls from the great golden fish as it swims back to the sky, shaped like a small fish with a forked tail. The flower lamp needs it.
journal.veilborne.dream.twig.text: As the roots draw back, a small twig falls from the deer's antlers with a tiny tree still growing on it. Hang it on a wall and fireflies come to it at night.
journal.veilborne.dream.flute: Blow it under open Overworld sky to call a complete verdant dream. It is not consumed while another weather is under way or the sky is covered.
journal.veilborne.dream.full.text: The reward of the vine enclosure, and now and then what comes up in a hoofprint. It grows a taller dream tree with gold-edged leaves, some in honey-coloured flower. Dream trees never spread and never shed.
journal.veilborne.dream.note.0: The forest, the roots, the dream tree and the petal path are sights in the sky; they place no real blocks and never touch your crops. Only a seed you plant yourself grows a real tree.
journal.veilborne.dream.note.1: The leaf-light, the leaf-fish and the flower patterns on the land can each be turned off in the client settings. Use a flower lamp any time to call its little school in or let it out.
journal.veilborne.dream.note.2: Carry a drifting leaf charm and a fall from a height becomes a slow drift, like a leaf; it wears a little each time.
journal.veilborne.dream.closing: When the last leaf had fallen only an ordinary cloud was left in the sky. But you remember it was once a forest.
tooltip.veilborne.shell: Use: the tide carries you back to where you boarded. One use.
tooltip.veilborne.message_chart: A wet sea chart is rolled up inside.
tooltip.veilborne.thread_core: A sliver of the golden needle, still hot. Carried while you sew sky-weaving lamps: any seam takes a single thread, and it can reach another dimension.
tooltip.veilborne.mirror_heart: Use: crush it, and chests, barrels, spawners and buried suspicious blocks within 32 blocks show through the ground for half a minute.
tooltip.veilborne.lasting.silver_lantern: No monster comes out of the dark within 24 blocks of it.
tooltip.veilborne.lasting.silent_lantern: Held: nothing you do can be heard by sculk sensors, shriekers or wardens.
tooltip.veilborne.lasting.still_candle: Within six blocks of it, no sound reaches the sculk or a warden.
tooltip.veilborne.lasting.loom_lantern: Use scarlet thread on one lamp and then another to sew them together; use one with an empty hand and the thread draws you to the other.
tooltip.veilborne.lasting.dream_leaves: Feed it to any animal: a grown one will want to breed, a young one grows. Also composts.
message.veilborne.voyage_begin: The old man nods and turns the bow the way you are looking...
message.veilborne.voyage_none: The old man looks for a long time, then shakes his head: there is nothing in the sea that way.
message.veilborne.voyage_sea: The boat comes down out of the sea above. In the water under you lies something the sea forgot. The old man presses a homeward shell into your hand.
message.veilborne.voyage_deep: The boat comes to rest over unfamiliar land. The old man points down: far, far below there is a city where no sound may be made. He presses a homeward shell into your hand.
message.veilborne.shell_home: The tide has carried you back to where you boarded.
message.veilborne.shell_empty: There is no tide in this shell.
message.veilborne.shell_far: The tide is too far away to reach you here.
message.veilborne.bottle_chart: A wet sea chart is rolled up inside: a red cross, drawn somewhere not far from here.
message.veilborne.vault_revealed: In the prism the tower's shadow runs on down into the ground: its foundation is buried right there. Dig down.
message.veilborne.vault_lost: In the prism the tower's shadow runs into the ground, and stops at something someone built.
message.veilborne.beasts_second: The splinters gather again: more glass beasts crawl out!
message.veilborne.beasts_cleared: The last glass beast breaks. At the shard's centre a heart is left, still glowing.
message.veilborne.heart_used: The heart breaks in your hand: %s hidden things show in its light.
message.veilborne.heart_none: The heart breaks in your hand and its light sweeps round: nothing is hidden near here.
message.veilborne.loom_threaded: The thread is tied to this lamp. Use scarlet thread on another to sew them together.
message.veilborne.loom_lost: The lamp the thread was tied to is gone.
message.veilborne.loom_needs_core: The thread cannot reach another world. Only with a needle core can it be sewn across.
message.veilborne.loom_short: So long a seam needs %s scarlet thread; you have %s.
message.veilborne.loom_linked: The two lamps are sewn together (%s scarlet thread used). Use one with an empty hand and the thread draws you to the other.
message.veilborne.loom_linked_core: The needle core takes the thread through: the lamps are sewn together with just %s thread.
message.veilborne.loom_alone: This lamp's thread has no other end yet. Use scarlet thread on one lamp and then another to sew them together.
message.veilborne.loom_where: The other end is to the %s, %s blocks away.
message.veilborne.loom_pulling: The scarlet thread draws tight... stand still.
message.veilborne.loom_let_go: You step away, and the thread goes slack.
message.veilborne.loom_broken: The other end of the thread has broken.
message.veilborne.pair_left: Where the needle came down into the land and up out of it, a sky-weaving lamp is left at each end, still joined by the thread.
message.veilborne.needle_core: You took the needle's whole weight at the ring's centre. A sliver of its core, still hot, is left in your hands.
message.veilborne.thread_held: You stand on the line and hold a length of it tight.
message.veilborne.snipped: You cut the land stitch. The world will not be sewn this time; thread ends lie all around.
message.veilborne.snipped_other: Someone has cut the land stitch; the world will not be sewn this time.
message.veilborne.loud: The sound carries a long way in the silence. Under the ground, something turns over.
message.veilborne.listener_none: Whatever is under the ground cannot find a way up.
message.veilborne.listener_survived: The first bird sings. It sinks slowly back into the ground and leaves you a handful of echo shards.
grade.veilborne.more: Next time, perhaps you will see more.
grade.veilborne.sea.0: Watched the whale cross the sky
grade.veilborne.sea.5: Let not one scale go out
grade.veilborne.moon.3: Saw the constellation from its one place
grade.veilborne.moon.5: Told it while the moonlight was still full
grade.veilborne.moon.6: Someone waved from the empty place
grade.veilborne.mirror.1: Found the door that is one too many
grade.veilborne.mirror.2: Your reflection fetched the echo mirror
grade.veilborne.mirror.3: Picked out the mirror of the present
grade.veilborne.mirror.4: Caught up with the late traveller
grade.veilborne.mirror.6: Beat both waves of glass beasts
grade.veilborne.thread.7: Caught the needle core at a ring's centre
grade.veilborne.thread.8: Saw the thread that holds you
grade.veilborne.hush.2: Raised a light to the procession
grade.veilborne.hush.5: Made a sound in the silence, and lived to hear the bird
grade.veilborne.dream.3: Guided a seed to the soil
grade.veilborne.dream.6: A seed landed in a hoofprint
journal.veilborne.legacy.head: What stays
journal.veilborne.sites.head: Your marks
journal.veilborne.grade.head: Completeness
journal.veilborne.legacy.0.text: Hold forward in the bow and the old man sails the way you look, setting you down over the nearest shipwreck, ocean ruin, ocean monument or ancient city that way, with a homeward shell to get back.
journal.veilborne.legacy.1.text: Where the scales came down the sea lingers in the water for three days: fish within 40 blocks and the line often brings up something of the sea above too, whale scales, nautilus shells, now and then a drift bottle with a treasure map. No water there? Dig a pond.
journal.veilborne.moon.legacy.0.text: A silver flower lantern keeps a little of the moonlight: within 24 blocks of it no monster comes out of the dark. Spawners and summons still work.
journal.veilborne.moon.legacy.1.text: Brew moon dew into an awkward potion. While it lasts, monsters only notice you from close by, and one already after you loses you once you are some way off. Redstone makes it last longer.
journal.veilborne.mirror.legacy.0.text: The tower that is only in the mirror stands over something real. Once the reflection is up, hold the observation prism on where the tower stands for a second or so and its shadow runs down into the ground; dig there for an old stone room and a chest.
journal.veilborne.mirror.legacy.1.text: When a shard bursts, beat every beast of the first wave and stay, and a larger second wave crawls out; beat that too and the shard leaves its heart. Crush it and the chests and spawners hidden nearby show through the ground.
journal.veilborne.thread.legacy.0.text: The two feet of the world stitch each keep a sky-weaving lamp, joined by the thread: use one with an empty hand and a moment later you stand beside the other. Use scarlet thread on one lamp and then another to sew your own; each 64 blocks takes a thread.
journal.veilborne.thread.legacy.1.text: Stand at the very centre of a warned ring with a binding knot and take the needle's whole weight (it hurts more, but you are not thrown), and a sliver of its core is left in your hands. Carry it while you sew and any seam takes one thread, even into another dimension.
journal.veilborne.hush.legacy.0.text: Held, nothing you do makes a sound: sculk sensors, shriekers and wardens cannot hear you. The ancient cities can be walked in at last, though a warden still sniffs.
journal.veilborne.hush.legacy.1.text: Set it down, and no sound within six blocks of it reaches the sculk or a warden. Light one by a shrieker and it will never scream again.
journal.veilborne.dream.legacy.0.text: A tree grown from a dream seed has a heart at the foot of its trunk. While its crown is in leaf, within 8 blocks (12 for a full seed's tree) crops grow twice as fast, young animals grow up and animals are ready to breed again twice as soon, and a pair often has twins.
journal.veilborne.dream.legacy.1.text: Every animal eats dream leaves: feed one to a grown animal and it will want to breed, to a young one and it grows. In a composter they nearly always make a layer. The tree now and then lets a sprig fall by itself.

phase.veilborne.dream.deer: The deer · Wait quietly under the dream tree
